items.question: Where does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity attain dissolution?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
The brahma-aperture is the locus of absorption.
This radiance has gone to absorption in that aperture.
items.inference: The radiance located in the throat-cavity reaches dissolution in the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The feminine subject implied by gatā is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
